params.cycleInput: The cycle schedule and bounded configuration snapshot to store.

params.finalizationInput: The sorted candidate ranking and cohort counts to store.

params.maxPositiveCandidates: The positive-allocation cap enforced by policy.

clearBallot(uint256,address).notice: Clears a voter's full signed ballot from a cycle.

createCycle(uint256,(uint64,uint64,uint6.notice: Stores a newly created Congress election cycle record.

currentCongressMembers().notice: Returns current Congress seat holders as a compact array.

cycleExists(uint256).notice: Returns true when a cycle record exists.

finalizeCycle(uint256,(address[],int256[.notice: Stores the finalized ranking, elected cohort, runner-up cohort, and active seat occupancy for a cycle.

getBallotAllocationAt(uint256,address,ui.notice: Returns a signed ballot allocation recorded for a voter in a cycle.

getBallotAllocationCount(uint256,address.notice: Returns the number of signed ballot allocations recorded for a voter in a cycle.

getBallotReceipt(uint256,address).notice: Returns the stored signed ballot receipt for a voter within a cycle.

getCandidate(uint256,address).notice: Returns the stored candidate record for a wallet within a cycle.

getCurrentOfficeTerm().notice: Returns the currently active Congress office term snapshot.

getCycle(uint256).notice: Returns the stored cycle record for a Congress election cycle.

getCycleCandidateAt(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns the candidate wallet stored at an index within the active cycle candidate list.

getCycleCandidateCount(uint256).notice: Returns the number of currently active candidates stored for a cycle.

getElectedCandidateAt(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns the elected candidate stored at an index for a finalized cycle.

getElectedCandidateCount(uint256).notice: Returns the number of elected candidates stored for a finalized cycle.

getRunnerUpAt(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns the runner-up candidate stored at an index for a finalized cycle.

getRunnerUpCount(uint256).notice: Returns the number of runner-up candidates stored for a finalized cycle.

getSeatRecord(uint32).notice: Returns the stored seat record for a current Congress seat index.

getStandingBallotAllocationAt(address,ui.notice: Returns a persistent standing ballot allocation for a voter.

getStandingBallotAllocationCount(address.notice: Returns the number of persistent standing ballot allocations for a voter.

getStandingBallotReceipt(address).notice: Returns the persistent standing ballot receipt for a voter.

isActiveCongressMember(address).notice: Returns true when a wallet currently occupies a Congress seat.

kernel().notice: Returns the kernel used for narrow write authorization.

latestCycleId().notice: Returns the latest sequential election cycle identifier created in the registry.

recordBallot(uint256,address,address[],i.notice: Stores or replaces a voter's full signed ballot in a cycle.

registerCandidate(uint256,address,bytes3.notice: Stores a candidate application and activates the candidate for the cycle.

vacateAndFillSeat(address).notice: Vacates an occupied Congress seat and immediately fills it from the next runner-up when available.

withdrawCandidate(uint256,address).notice: Withdraws an active candidate from a cycle before voting begins.
